Title: (LSJ) Mask of 1000 Faces and fizzling action

Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Suzanne Kadim (1 blood) attempts to Mind Numb an untapped Jackie.

1) Some minion attempts to block and Suzanne stealth through using
Elder Impersonation. Can Suzanne's controller François Villon with
some more blood on him play Mask of 1000 Faces before resolution (and
prevent the action from fizzling ) ?

2) Instead, Jackie plays superior Babble to untap random minion, which
taps her and makes her an invalid target for Mind Numb. Can François
Villon mask the action now that the target is invalid ? (He cannot
play Mind Numb on tapped Jackie then "No", or he could have played MN
on then-untapped-Jackie then "Yes" ? )

Thank you,

François

Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
My attempt to answer it correctly:

> Suzanne Kadim (1 blood) attempts to Mind Numb an untapped Jackie.
>
> 1) Some minion attempts to block and Suzanne stealth through using
> Elder Impersonation. Can Suzanne's controller François Villon with
> some more blood on him play Mask of 1000 Faces before resolution (and
> prevent the action from fizzling ) ?

Yes. You can play actionmodifiers during action. The situation doesn't
restrict you playing a Mask.

> 2) Instead, Jackie plays superior Babble to untap random minion, which
> taps her and makes her an invalid target for Mind Numb. Can François
> Villon mask the action now that the target is invalid ? (He cannot
> play Mind Numb on tapped Jackie then "No", or he could have played MN
> on then-untapped-Jackie then "Yes" ? )
>

When you announced the action it was legal, so you can attampt the
action. And therefor play a mask.
During the resolution of the action the target is illigal, so it
fails.

Am I right?

Gr,
Oortje

No, you can still block the action. If it reaches resolution without
any valid targets, though, the action fails.

Messages.Body:
Oortje wrote:
> My attempt to answer it correctly:
>
>> Suzanne Kadim (1 blood) attempts to Mind Numb an untapped Jackie.
>>
>> 1) Some minion attempts to block and Suzanne stealth through using
>> Elder Impersonation. Can Suzanne's controller François Villon with
>> some more blood on him play Mask of 1000 Faces before resolution (and
>> prevent the action from fizzling ) ?
>
> Yes. You can play actionmodifiers during action. The situation doesn't
> restrict you playing a Mask.

Yes, since Francois has obf, so could have played the Elder Impersonation (and
has PRE, so could have attempted the Mind Numb).

>> 2) Instead, Jackie plays superior Babble to untap random minion, which
>> taps her and makes her an invalid target for Mind Numb. Can François
>> Villon mask the action now that the target is invalid ? (He cannot
>> play Mind Numb on tapped Jackie then "No", or he could have played MN
>> on then-untapped-Jackie then "Yes" ? )
>>
> When you announced the action it was legal, so you can attampt the
> action. And therefor play a mask.
> During the resolution of the action the target is illigal, so it
> fails.
>
> Am I right?

No. Mask: "usable by a ... vampire ... who *is* capable of performing the action."

The action is illegal (target is not valid), so no minion is capable of
performing it. So no minion can Mask it.

Is the following "trick" legal, then :

- Suzanne (1 blood) attempts to mind numb Jackie.
- She stealth through using elder impersonation.
- Suzanne's controller asks for any other block attempt.
- All players decline the block, since they expect the action to
fizzle.
- Then Francois masks the action after blocks are declined and before
the resolution (ensuring the action will not fizzle and will not be
blocked since all blocks have been declined) ?

Thank you again,

François

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


At a guess I would say no, because asking for any other block attempts
passes the impulse, and as no block attempts are declared, there is
now no longer a window for action modifiers as the action immediately
moves to action resolution... I think...

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


You can play action modifiers after blocks are declined. See also
Conditioning. There's nothing wrong with this play. Similarly, if
Smudge is bleeding, Arika can Mask in after blocks are declined and
then play Conditioning.

witness1
